Description: Show the user-facing help and features guide.
IntentPhrases: show me what sleuth can do
DisambiguationNotes: Use this when the user wants guidance, capabilities, or a help screen.

Description: Show the full command reference for Sleuth.
DisambiguationNotes: Use this when the user explicitly wants the command list rather than one specific action.

Description: Run workspace diagnostics for config, Slack connectivity, disk access, reminders, stats, OpenAI, and Notion.
DisambiguationNotes: Prefer this when the user wants system health or troubleshooting information.

Description: Dump the published rebalance reminders export file (the artifact the rebalance-OS dashboard consumes) for debugging, with UTC and workspace-local timestamps.
IntentPhrases: show what got synced to rebalance
debug the git pulse reminders export
DisambiguationNotes: Use this to inspect the actual published reminders-<workspace>.json from the export-repo repo, including its freshness/heartbeat, rather than the live in-process reminders.

Description: Show the published rebalance reminders export as Slack-formatted reminder and memory lines instead of the raw JSON file.
IntentPhrases: show the rebalance reminders nicely formatted
give me a readable version of the rebalance export
list the published rebalance reminders without the json
DisambiguationNotes: Use this when the user wants the published rebalance export as readable Slack lines; use show-rebalance-reminders when they want the raw JSON file.

Description: Run the full Jest suite and post the summarized result.
DisambiguationNotes: This is expensive enough that rmm ifl should only suggest it, not auto-run it.

Description: Synthesize a freeform code-change request and dispatch it to Claude Code Cloud, which opens a PR. The session/PR link is posted back to the thread.
SyntaxExamples: @Sleuth AI code-task add a retry to the GitHub sync fetch
@Sleuth AI code-task make the daily digest skip empty channels
DisambiguationNotes: Use this only when an admin explicitly wants Sleuth to modify a codebase via Claude Code Cloud. High risk and admin-only, so rmm must never auto-run it — only suggest it.

Description: Gracefully restart the Sleuth process.
DisambiguationNotes: Because this restarts the service, rmm ifl must not auto-execute it.

Description: Show the current Sleuth version number.
IntentPhrases: what version of sleuth is this

Description: Force-run the daily digest immediately.
DisambiguationNotes: This has real downstream side effects, so rmm ifl should not auto-run it.

Description: Show the current workspace and channel model configuration.
IntentPhrases: what are the current ai models
DisambiguationNotes: Use this when the user wants model status across the workspace/channel.

Description: Show this channel's override and effective chat model.
Aliases: what model is this channel using
IntentPhrases: what model is active in this channel
what model are you running on this channel
which model are you running right now
what model are you using right now
which model is running in this channel
DisambiguationNotes: Use this for channel-specific model inspection, not workspace-wide status.
Model-identity questions like 'what model are you?' map here — the answer must come from runtime config, never from the chat model's self-knowledge.

Description: Set a chat-model override for only the current channel.
Aliases: use this model in this channel
IntentPhrases: use gpt 5 only in this channel
set this channel to gpt 5 mini
DisambiguationNotes: Use this when the user explicitly says only this channel should change.

Description: Clear the current channel's override and revert to the workspace default model.
IntentPhrases: go back to the workspace default in this channel
DisambiguationNotes: Use this when the user wants to undo a per-channel model override.

Description: Change the workspace default chat model.
IntentPhrases: what is the command to change models
what command do I use to change models
DisambiguationNotes: If the user mentions one model without saying complex, date extraction, or this channel only, assume they mean the workspace default chat model.
Discovery framings like 'how do I change models?' or 'change models' (without specifying complex/this channel) also map here — see rmm-instructions.md rule 6.

Description: Set the experimental command-router mode (off, shadow, or active) for this workspace.
IntentPhrases: switch the router to active mode
DisambiguationNotes: Toggles the GH-397 Gemini Flash Lite router experiment. 'shadow' logs a corpus with zero authority; 'active' lets Flash Lite take over command resolution; 'off' disables it. Admin/owner only; in-memory (resets on restart).

Description: Change only the complex/date-extraction model.
IntentPhrases: use gpt 5 only for hard reasoning
DisambiguationNotes: Use this only when the user clearly references the complex model, date extraction, or difficult reasoning tasks.

Description: Change both the workspace default chat model and the complex/date-extraction model.
IntentPhrases: change chat to gpt 5 mini and complex to gpt 5
update the default and complex models together
DisambiguationNotes: Use this only when the user clearly specifies two different targets or explicitly says both/default and complex.

Description: Search the web through OpenAI Responses API and reply with sourced results.
DisambiguationNotes: Prefer this for generic web lookups when the user does not explicitly ask for Google or Gemini.

Description: Search the web through Google Gemini and reply with sourced results.
DisambiguationNotes: Prefer this when the user explicitly says Google or Gemini.

Description: Search the connected Notion workspace.
SyntaxExamples: @Sleuth AI search notion for onboarding docs
DisambiguationNotes: This is handled by the Notion module, so rmm can suggest it but should not auto-execute it.

Description: Read the text out of an uploaded image using Vision OCR and post it back, without creating anything.
IntentPhrases: read the text in this screenshot
extract the text from this photo
pull the words out of this image
DisambiguationNotes: Use this when the user wants the text itself. If they want an interactive Slack List built from the image, use make-list-from-image.
Requires an image attachment on the same message.

Description: Turn text — pasted, quoted, or already scanned out of an image — into an interactive Slack List.
SyntaxExamples: @Sleuth AI convert text into slack list
@Sleuth AI convert text into slack list 1. Fix railing $200 2. PPE violation
Aliases: convert the text into a slack list
make a slack list from this
IntentPhrases: turn this text into a list
make a slack list out of what i just pasted
convert these items into a checklist
build a list from this text
put this into a slack list
DisambiguationNotes: Use this when the source is text. When the source is an attached image, make-list-from-image handles extraction and creation in one step.

With an image attached, generic list phrasings (e.g. 'make a slack list from this') auto-route to the image list; text-specific ones ('build a list from this text') deliberately stay unsupported. This boundary is pinned by tests/ocr-provider-pin-and-commands.test.js.
With no text supplied it falls back to the thread's context memory, so it composes after scan-image-for-text.

Description: Turn an attached image into an interactive Slack List in one step — Vision OCR extraction plus list creation.
SyntaxExamples: @Sleuth AI make a list from this image
@Sleuth AI make a todo list from the attached image
Aliases: make a list from this image
create a list from this image
build a checklist from this image
IntentPhrases: make a todo list out of this screenshot
turn this image into a slack list
extract the items in this photo into a list
generate a task list from the attached image
DisambiguationNotes: Use this when the source is an attached image and the user wants a Slack List. For text-only output use scan-image-for-text; when the source is already text use convert-text-into-slack-list.
Requires an image attachment on the same message. Natural-language phrasings also route here through the attachment resolver.

Description: Fetch a public Stratalist list and show it in Slack without creating reminders.
IntentPhrases: look up a stratalist list by slug
DisambiguationNotes: Use this for read-only display of a public Stratalist list. It does not create reminders.

Description: Re-read the operator-managed Clients Slack List into the Sleuth client lookup so reminder client-name inference picks up new clients and aliases without a code deploy.
IntentPhrases: update the clients lookup from slack
pull in the latest client names
DisambiguationNotes: This reads the Clients Slack List and rewrites the per-workspace client overlay. It does not create reminders or edit the list.

Description: Search pending reminders across the workspace by keyword or close typo match.
DisambiguationNotes: Use this for reminder/task search across the workspace.

Description: Show high-level PROJECT-tagged reminders, a shortcut for searching reminders by the PROJECT keyword. Trailing keywords narrow within projects.
DisambiguationNotes: Use this for high-level PROJECT reminders; expands to 'search reminders PROJECT <keywords>'.

Description: Search pending reminders only from the current channel.
DisambiguationNotes: Use this when the user explicitly scopes reminder search to the current channel.

Description: Search reminders the user created, is assigned to, or is mentioned in.
DisambiguationNotes: Use this when the user wants only their own reminder scope.

Description: List all pending reminders.
DisambiguationNotes: Use this for a workspace-wide pending reminder list.

Description: List pending reminders only from the current channel.
DisambiguationNotes: Use this when the user wants current-channel reminder scope.

Description: List only pending reminders with GitHub links.
DisambiguationNotes: Use this for GitHub-scoped reminder lists.

Description: Recap the current calendar week (Sun–Sat): reminder tasks completed this week and the tasks still open.
IntentPhrases: what did we get done this week
show what was completed and what is still open this week
give me a summary of this week's tasks
DisambiguationNotes: Use this for a Sun–Sat recap of completed vs. still-open tasks. Use show-reminders when you only want the open list.

Description: List reminders the user created, is assigned to, or is mentioned in.
DisambiguationNotes: Use this when the user wants their own reminder scope.

Description: AI-ranked priority view of a user's open reminders, with a deterministic grouping of all their open work by relationship.
IntentPhrases: what should jane focus on today
what should i work on first
DisambiguationNotes: Use this for a prioritized focus list. Use show-me-projects to group a user's work into client/project buckets instead.

Description: Group a user's open reminders into client and project buckets, ordered by urgency.
DisambiguationNotes: Use this to see the shape of the work by client/project. Use show-me for a prioritized focus list instead.

Description: Enable automatic reminder detection in the current channel.
IntentPhrases: turn reminders on in this channel
DisambiguationNotes: This changes channel behavior and is handled by the reminders module, so rmm should suggest it but not auto-run it.

Description: Disable automatic reminder detection in the current channel.
IntentPhrases: turn reminders off in this channel
DisambiguationNotes: This changes channel behavior and is handled by the reminders module, so rmm should suggest it but not auto-run it.

Description: Trigger scheduled reminder delivery immediately.
DisambiguationNotes: Handled by the reminders module with real side effects, so rmm should only suggest it.

Description: Manually trigger GitHub status synchronization.
DisambiguationNotes: Handled by the reminders module with side effects, so rmm should only suggest it.

Description: Test GitHub PAT connectivity, optionally against one specific issue or PR URL.
DisambiguationNotes: Use this for GitHub sync diagnostics; rmm should suggest it but not auto-run it.

Description: Show usage statistics for the workspace.
DisambiguationNotes: Handled outside ChatModule, so rmm can suggest it but should not auto-run it.

Description: Run a lightweight connectivity check.
IntentPhrases: check if the bot is up
DisambiguationNotes: Handled outside ChatModule, so rmm can suggest it but should not auto-run it.

Description: Summarize the latest shipped Sleuth changes from the changelog.
DisambiguationNotes: Use this when the user wants a release recap rather than repository docs.

Description: Translate plain English into the closest exact Sleuth command.
SyntaxExamples: @Sleuth AI rmm remind me to check invoices
IntentPhrases: figure out the right sleuth command
translate my request into a command
which exact command should i use
DisambiguationNotes: Use this when the user knows the goal but not the exact command syntax.

Description: Resolve plain English to a Sleuth command and auto-run only the low-risk commands explicitly allowed for IFL.
SyntaxExamples: @Sleuth AI rmm ifl show my reminders
IntentPhrases: find the command and run it if safe
auto run the safest matching command
translate this and do it if allowed
DisambiguationNotes: Use this when the user wants convenience but only within the pre-authorized low-risk command set.

Description: If the workspace has a registered remote RAG project, query that codebase from Slack by project slug.
SyntaxExamples: @Sleuth AI ask-code client-b how does delta sync work
IntentPhrases: ask the client-b codebase about delta sync
search code for a configured project slug
DisambiguationNotes: Use this for a registered remote RAG project, not Sleuth's own repo.

Description: Capture the current Slack thread into Sleuth's searchable memory so you can recall it later.
DisambiguationNotes: Run at the end of a thread; retrieve it later with 'recall'.

Description: File a GitHub issue on the configured issue repo with the thread transcript as evidence.
SyntaxExamples: @Sleuth AI send to github: reminder fired incorrectly
IntentPhrases: file a github issue from this thread
DisambiguationNotes: Reply in thread to the conversation to capture; channel-level mentions have no prior context. Files on sleuth-app only.
CommandsListNotes: Reply in thread to the messages you want to capture, then run this command from that thread reply — not as a new channel message.
Optional inline title after a colon: send to github: reminder fired on non-actionable message
Requires workspace GITHUB_PAT with issues:write; Sleuth posts the new GitHub issue URL back in-thread.

Description: Fuzzy-search threads captured with 'remember above' and get ranked results with permalinks.
IntentPhrases: recall what we discussed about checkout
find the thread about the migration
DisambiguationNotes: Searches remembered Slack threads (captured via 'remember above'), not reminders or the codebase.

Description: Query the configured WP DB Toolkit RAG service from Slack.
SyntaxExamples: @Sleuth AI ask-woo what broke in Woo staging
IntentPhrases: search the wp toolkit knowledge base
DisambiguationNotes: Use this only when the workspace has the optional WP DB Toolkit integration configured.

Description: Reserved placeholder for the future buffered multi-step web-search mode.
DisambiguationNotes: Keep this documented so the placeholder route stays visible until the advanced mode ships.

Description: Answer natural-language questions about which OpenAI or ChatGPT models are currently available to this workspace.
SyntaxExamples: @Sleuth AI what OpenAI models are currently available?
IntentPhrases: what models are available right now
which chatgpt models can this workspace use
DisambiguationNotes: This is a natural-language route, not a literal named command.

Description: Search reminders assigned to or mentioning a specific user.
IntentPhrases: find tasks for a specific user
DisambiguationNotes: Use this when the request explicitly targets one user rather than the current user or the whole workspace.

Description: List reminders assigned to or mentioning a specific user.
IntentPhrases: list tasks for a specific user
DisambiguationNotes: Use this when the user wants another person's task list rather than their own.

Description: Create a reminder from the task message immediately above your thread reply. If neither the source task nor the command includes a time, it defaults to tomorrow at 8:00 AM.
SyntaxExamples: @Sleuth AI make a Sleuth reminder for @jane based on task above
Aliases: set reminder based on task above
IntentPhrases: make a reminder for jane from the message above
turn the task above into a reminder for jane
create a reminder from the thread message above
DisambiguationNotes: Use this as a thread reply under the source task. If the task already includes a due-time phrase, Sleuth keeps that instead of applying the default.

Description: Confirm a pending multi-task proposal in the current thread, creating the proposed reminders. Anyone replying in the thread can confirm.
IntentPhrases: approve these tasks and create them
yes go ahead and create the tasks
DisambiguationNotes: Only meaningful as a thread reply after Sleuth has posted a pending multi-task proposal; matches the whole message (e.g. bare "confirm" or the white_check_mark emoji), not a keyword within a longer sentence.

Description: Create a one-time Slack List snapshot of reminders assigned to a specific user.
IntentPhrases: make a slack list for janes tasks
export janes assigned reminders to a list
DisambiguationNotes: This creates a new snapshot list and does not keep syncing it afterward.

Description: Pick one pending reminder at random and render its output format for debugging.
IntentPhrases: show a random reminder debug view
DisambiguationNotes: Debug-only reminder output command for admins.

Description: Render one specific pending reminder by ID for debugging.
IntentPhrases: show reminder output for this id
DisambiguationNotes: Debug-only reminder output command for admins when you know the reminder ID.
